note: Signed objects of section 9.4. Keys from seeds derived from labels; ML-DSA-65 in its deterministic mode (rnd all zero, the domain label as context), which an implementation verifies like a hedged signature. Every accepted object verifies under the recorded key `approver`; every rejected one does not. signedBytesHex is the length-prefixed encoding of 9.1.
